artworks.title: John Digby, Earl of Bristol, Ambassador to Spain
artworks.description: This print is a portrait of a man. He is shown in an upper body view facing slightly to the right, holding a thin staff or rod in his right hand. He has a mustache, a goatee, and round eyes that look out at us. He has pale skin and short, light hair. He wears a large hat with a decorative emblem, a ruffled collar, and a doublet with intricate patterns and lines of small buttons. The oval portrait is framed with ribbon-like decorations and has text around the border. The background is filled with dark crosshatching, and there is a block of text at the bottom of the print.

artworks.title: John Digby, Earl of Bristol, Ambassador to Spain
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring a man from the waist up. He is seated, facing slightly to the left with a straight expression. He has a prominent mustache and pointed beard. He wears a wide-brimmed hat with a large decoration, a decorative jacket, a high ruff collar, and lace cuffs. One of his hands holds the hilt of a sword or staff. The man is enclosed in an ornate oval frame with decorative scrollwork, text identifying him, and a crest at the top. The background has a textured pattern, and text at the bottom provides information about the man's identity and titles.

artworks.title: William Cecill, First Baron Burghley
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man with a long beard and mustache, wearing a cap with an emblem, a high-collared garment with intricate detailing, and a chain. He holds a wand or staff. The background includes ornate decoration, coats of arms, garlands, and Latin inscriptions. The bottom of the image contains a text panel detailing his titles and accomplishments.

artworks.title: Sir Julius Caesar, Master of the Roules
artworks.description: This image depicts a man in a portrait framed within an ornate oval border. He is facing slightly to the left, with a long, pointed beard and mustache. He wears a tall hat, a richly decorated garment, and an elaborate ruff around his neck and sleeves. The man is holding a rolled paper or scroll in his right hand. The background features scrollwork, decorative elements, and a coat of arms above his head. An inscription at the bottom of the frame provides information about the person depicted.

artworks.title: Christian IV of Denmark
artworks.description: The image shows an oval portrait of a man from the chest up. He is facing forward in a slightly turned position to the right. The man has a mustache and goatee, with short-cropped hair that is hidden under a hat. The hat is adorned with decorative feathers and a band with intricate designs. He is wearing richly adorned clothing, featuring an elaborate ruff collar and a cloak with detailed embellishments. The background shows a frame with Latin inscriptions. Below the portrait, there is additional text and a shield emblem with a crown on top. The entire image is presented in a detailed line engraving style.

artworks.title: Henry Stuart, Lord Darnley
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of an individual from the waist up, seated in a dignified posture and looking directly at the viewer with a composed expression. The person has detailed facial features, including eyes, a nose, and lips, along with short, styled hair. They wear an elaborate hat with a feather, a richly decorated garment with patterns and embellishments, a fur collar, a chain necklace with a pendant, and hold a fan in their right hand. Their left hand is resting against the clothing. The individual is framed by circles with text and scrolls, with a textured background and heraldic symbols on the sides.

artworks.title: Henry Stuart, Lord Darnley
artworks.description: The engraving shows a bust-length portrait of a man identified as the Prince of Albany, Henry Lord Darnley. He faces slightly to his left, with a smooth complexion, prominent eyes, a small mouth, short wavy hair, and an elaborately adorned hat with a large plume. He wears an opulent garment with fleur-de-lis patterns and fur trimmings, a lace collar, and ornate jewelry. The portrait is framed by a divider with heraldic symbols like a unicorn and a shield with crowns and floral motifs. The background has a textured pattern, and the bottom includes a dedication and decorative elements.

artworks.title: Marc Antonis De Dominis
artworks.description: The image shows an older man seated, facing slightly to his right. He has a serious expression, with a prominent nose, neatly trimmed beard, and mustache. He wears a tall hat and a robe with a decorative collar. He is holding a book or manuscript. The background includes ornate decorative elements like scrollwork and a coat of arms, along with inscriptions.

artworks.title: Marc Antonis De Dominis
artworks.description: The image shows a half-length portrait of a man looking forward. He has a beard and moustache, wearing a cap and robe. In his hand, he holds a rolled paper. Surrounding the portrait are ornate architectural engravings and text identifying the individual. The background is filled with patterns, coats of arms, and a globe.

artworks.title: Marc Antonis De Dominis
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated from the waist up. He is turned slightly to the right, looking directly at the viewer. He has a full beard and mustache, a receding hairline, and short hair. The man wears a distinctive hat, a robe with ornate sleeves, and a high-collared tunic. He is holding a quill pen over an open book. The setting includes a table with writing materials, a stack of books, and more books on shelves in the background.

artworks.title: Frederick Christian of Denmark
artworks.description: The engraved portrait features an upper-body depiction of a noble person in formal attire with heraldic symbols. The person is positioned frontally with a slight turn of the head. The facial features include a youthful face with smooth skin, slightly plump cheeks, small lips, and a calm expression. The hair is styled in soft curls framing the face. The clothing is elaborate with a high lace ruff around the neck, a sash adorned with a rosette, and sleeves embellished with intricate patterns. The person holds an object resembling a baton or staff. Ornate designs surround the figure, including an angelic figure with wings above and a shield with a coat of arms. The detailed background adds to the regal air of the composition. Text within the circular frame and below the portrait provides additional context or titles.

artworks.title: Frederick Christian of Denmark
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of an individual from the waist up in an elaborate frame with an angelic figure above. The person faces forward with a slightly turned body posture, wavy hair falling around their face, and delicately drawn facial features. They are dressed in richly detailed clothing with intricate patterns, including a high lace ruffle collar and a sash diagonally across their chest. The individual appears to be holding something with their left hand. In the background, there is an ornate design with an angel and heraldic symbols within an oval frame. An inscription in Latin encircles the portrait, with additional text below providing details about the person's identity and lineage.

artworks.title: John, Lord Harrington of Exton
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up, seated and facing slightly to the left. His facial features include a defined jawline, a straight nose, and a pair of eyes that look directly at the viewer, while his hairstyle is short and neatly combed back. He is dressed in attire indicative of nobility, including a finely detailed doublet and an elaborate ruffled collar. The garment is ornate, with decorative patterns and embellishments. Around him is an oval frame with inscriptions, and surrounding this frame are stylized heraldic elements, including a lion on the left and a crest on the right. The background is filled with intricate engravings and inscriptions containing text or poetry at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Isabella Clara Eugenia, Infanta of Spain, wife of Archduke of Austria
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait engraving of a woman, facing forward with a neutral expression. She has a high forehead, defined eyebrows, and a well-structured nose and lips. Her hair is styled up with flower decorations. She wears an elaborate dress with a high ruffled lace collar, detailed patterns, and embellishments. She also wears pearl earrings and an ornate jewelry piece. The background contains swirling lines and text identifying her as Isabella Clara Eugenia, Infanta of Spain, Duchesse of Austria and Burgundy, and Princess of Belgium. Text and a coat of arms are displayed at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Tobias Matthew, D.D., Archbishop of York
artworks.description: The image depicts a historical portrait of a man seated in an ornate frame. He is positioned facing forward with his eyes looking slightly to the side, showing sharp facial features such as a prominent nose and a beard. The man wears historical clothing, including a doublet and a cape with intricate patterns. His hands are clasped in front of him on a book. The border features cherubic figures, trumpets, and a coat of arms dated "1624." The background has engraving texture, and the bottom of the portrait includes Latin text.

artworks.title: Tobias Matthew, D.D., Archbishop of York
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a seated man. He is looking directly at the viewer with a calm expression. The man has a long, full beard and mustache, with dark hair partly covered by a cap. He is wearing a clerical or academic gown with a high ruffled collar and a broad-brimmed hat. His attire includes a long robe with wide sleeves, and his hands are folded across a book or document in front of him. The portrait is framed within an ornate oval border with cherubic figures, angels, and floral motifs. Above the oval is a decorative crest. The background features intricate engravings, Latin inscriptions, and suggests a formal, historical setting.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas More
artworks.description: The image shows a formal portrait of a seated man facing slightly to the left. He is holding a staff or scroll, with a serious expression, a distinctive haircut, and clean-shaven face. He wears an elaborate robe with fur collar, a cap, and a chain with a medallion around his neck. The background includes intricate designs, Latin inscriptions, a coat of arms, and a small, round portrait of another figure. Decorative scrolls, a small banner with text, and an oval frame surround the portrait on slightly discolored rectangular paper.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Overbury
artworks.description: The image depicts Sir Thomas Overbury from the waist up. He is seated, resting his head on his left hand while holding a quill in his right hand. Overbury has a neatly trimmed mustache and beard, and short, curly hair. He wears a richly detailed attire with a large ruff collar and a long robe with embroidered sleeves. Objects around him include a piece of paper with writing, a quill, an ink pot, and a book. A coat of arms is to his right, and to the left is a panel with a title identifying him as "Sir Thomas Overbury Knight Ætat. 32." The background is plain.

artworks.title: Edmond Shaffield, First Earl of Malgrave
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the waist up. He is positioned facing slightly to the viewer's right, with his left arm partially visible in ornate clothing. The man has a neatly groomed beard and mustache, and his hair is styled back from his forehead. He wears a richly adorned garment featuring elaborate patterns and a high lace ruff around his neck. A pendant hangs from a chain at his chest. Surrounding him is an intricately detailed oval frame with scrollwork and a coat of arms above. The background is a textured pattern, and the lower part of the frame contains text identifying him as "The Right Honorable Lord Edmond Baron Sheffield," along with other titles.

artworks.title: Jon van Olden-Bernevelt
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man with defined facial features and a stern expression. He has a beard and mustache, with short, neatly arranged hair. He is dressed in an ornate garment with a high, elaborate ruffled collar and a fur-trimmed coat. The background includes decorative elements like cherubs, scrollwork, and a heraldic shield. The engraving features an oval border with an inscription, Latin text in the border, and additional text below the central portrait element.

artworks.title: William Perkins, D.D.
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body view of a man seated with an open book in his lap, from an engraving. He is facing forward, looking directly at the viewer. The man has a beard and mustache, short, well-combed hair, and is dressed in period attire with a high-collared garment featuring a ruff collar and a robe with ornate buttons. His hands are holding an open book. In the background, two figures are engraved, one resembling a skeleton with a spear and another a winged figure. The background is filled with detailed ornate designs. Text along the top and bottom provides biographical information about the individual in the image.

artworks.title: William Perkins, D.D.
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man seated with his body slightly turned to the left, gazing directly at the viewer. He has a high forehead with receding hair, and a well-groomed beard and mustache. His attire consists of a buttoned garment with an elaborate ruff around the neck. He holds an open book in one hand. Surrounding him is an ornately decorated frame featuring two figures at the top; one skeletal and the other a winged creature with a staff. The background within the frame is a simple, hatched pattern, with a floral decoration at the lower sides. The bottom section of the image contains text about the person depicted.

artworks.title: Sir Philip Sidney
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man wearing formal armor and a cloak, holding a baton or rod across his chest. The man has a mustache and is depicted in a stylized position, with his face turned slightly to the left. The portrait is surrounded by a decorative border featuring cherubs, heraldic symbols, and text in Latin and English at the bottom.

artworks.title: Robert Carr, Earl of Somerset and His Countess
artworks.description: The image depicts a man and a woman. The man is on the left, slightly behind the woman. He is wearing a detailed outfit with a hat, feather, ruffled collar, cloak, and doublet. The woman is standing in front, holding her dress with one hand. She has delicate features, light eyebrows, and styled hair with jewels. She wears an ornate dress with a high collar, large sleeves, lace, and jewels. She has multiple pearl necklaces. The background includes a checkered floor and a coat of arms in the upper right corner.
